content:
Sample: secbench_oss_libxml2.ossfuzz-417247563
Project: libxml2
Public id: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5866431243943936

Issue description:
In libxml2, `xmlEscapeText()` retains a pointer to a stack-allocated temporary buffer after that buffer leaves scope. Later XML escaping reads through the stale pointer, causing a stack-use-after-scope.
